raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
This PR has two Intel XPU fixes: the ERNIE-4.5-VL visual-token mask, and dLLM serving on `intel_xpu`, which moved here from #41773.

## Motivation

### 1. ERNIE-4.5-VL: visual-token mask on every decode step

On Intel XPU, `baidu/ERNIE-4.5-VL-28B-A3B-PT` crashes during docvqa after a few dozen documents:

```
RuntimeError: level_zero backend failed with error: 40 (UR_RESULT_ERROR_OUT_OF_RESOURCES)
```

`Ernie4_5_VLMoeForConditionalGeneration.forward` calls `_set_visual_token_mask` on every forward, including every decode step. Each call allocates small device tensors (`_visual_token_ids_tensor_cache.to(device)`, `torch.as_tensor(pad_values, device=...)`, `torch.cat`, `torch.isin`). The level_zero backend does not reclaim them, so one prefill plus N decode steps per document adds up until device memory runs out.

The mask only decides which tokens go to the vision experts (`ernie45_moe_vl.py`). A `None` mask and an all-False mask take the same text-experts path, which is also the path CUDA-graph capture uses. Decode tokens are generated text, so the per-step mask is always all-False.

### 2. dLLM serving on intel_xpu

Diffusion LMs (`--dllm-algorithm`) on `--attention-backend intel_xpu` hit two XPU bugs:

1. **Crash at warmup** (`inclusionAI/LLaDA2.1-mini`, `JetLM/SDAR-8B-Chat`): `AttributeError: 'NoneType' object has no attribute 'shape'` in `XPUAttentionBackend.init_forward_metadata`. `ForwardMode.DLLM_EXTEND` is in `is_extend()` but not in `is_extend_or_draft_extend_or_mixed()`, which guards the XPU extend-metadata branch. On CUDA, `DLLM_EXTEND` runs via CUDA graph and never reaches this eager branch; on XPU it matches no branch and leaves `metadata.page_table = None`.
2. **Blank output** (`JetLM/SDAR-8B-Chat`): `_dllm_page_size` sets `page_size` to the dLLM block size (4 for SDAR, 32 for LLaDA2), overriding the intel_xpu 64/128 page constraint. The sgl-kernel-xpu paged kernels are exact at page 1/64/128. At page 2/4/8/16, a query block whose KV spans more than one page returns wrong output (max abs err 1.4 to 3.9 at page 4), and SDAR generates `\n\n\n...`.

## Modifications

### 1. ERNIE-4.5-VL

- In `python/sglang/srt/models/ernie45_vl.py`, build the mask only for non-decode batches that contain image or video inputs; otherwise set `visual_token_mask = None`.
- Image and video prefill/extend batches still build the mask, so vision routing is unchanged. Decode and text-only batches take the text-experts path, as before.

### 2. dLLM

`python/sglang/srt/layers/attention/xpu_backend.py`:

- Route `DLLM_EXTEND` into the extend-metadata branch (a multi-query block forward, so extend-shaped metadata is correct).
- For non-MLA attention without DCP, index KV per token (`page_size = 1`) when the page size is not 1/64/128. This reuses the existing page-1 path; the KV pool layout is unchanged.

Both dLLM changes are in the XPU attention backend only.

#42627 carries earlier versions of both fixes, without the video-only mask fix and the page-size fallback.

## Accuracy Tests

### 1. ERNIE-4.5-VL

Intel Arc Pro B60, tp-size 4, `--attention-backend intel_xpu`, lmms_eval `docvqa_val`:

| Run | Docs | Result |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Before, serialized (`num_concurrent=1`, `--max-running-requests 1`) | ~44 | crash, error 40 |
| After, same settings | 80/80 | 368,682 tokens, no error 40 |
| After, `num_concurrent=8`, `--mem-fraction-static 0.70`, no serialization flags | 150/150 | anls 0.9137, no error 40 |

The anls run sets `enable_thinking=false` in the chat template. ERNIE-4.5-VL opens a `<think>` block by default, and docvqa's short generation budget cuts it off before the answer.

Reproduce (serialized run):

```bash
SGLANG_USE_SGL_XPU=1 python3 -m sglang.launch_server --model-path baidu/ERNIE-4.5-VL-28B-A3B-PT \
  --device xpu --tp-size 4 --mem-fraction-static 0.85 --trust-remote-code --port 30000 \
  --context-length 8192 --disable-radix-cache --disable-overlap-schedule --max-running-requests 1 \
  --enable-multimodal --attention-backend intel_xpu

python3 -m lmms_eval --model openai_compatible \
  --model_args model_version=baidu/ERNIE-4.5-VL-28B-A3B-PT,num_concurrent=1 \
  --tasks docvqa_val --batch_size 16 --limit 80
```

### 2. dLLM

Intel Arc Pro B60, `--dllm-algorithm LowConfidence --attention-backend intel_xpu`, gsm8k 5-shot chat.

`JetLM/SDAR-8B-Chat`, tp1:

| | docs | `\boxed{}` answer correct |
|---|---|---|
| crash fix only | 10 | 0/10 (blank output) |
| this PR | 10 | 7/10 (triton backend: 7/10) |
| this PR | 1319 | **0.8635** (1139/1319) |

Counting answers written as `The answer is: $N$` without `\boxed{}` (last number in the response): 0.9189. Paper: 88.4. lm_eval flexible-extract reads 0.0804 on this model because its regex takes the trailing `$.` from `$\boxed{N}$.` (1176 of 1319 docs).

`inclusionAI/LLaDA2.1-mini`, tp2 (page 32), limit 10: flexible / strict 0.8 / 0.5, same before and after the page-size change.

```
python -m sglang.launch_server --model-path JetLM/SDAR-8B-Chat --trust-remote-code \
  --attention-backend intel_xpu --dllm-algorithm LowConfidence --tp-size 1
```

## Speed Tests and Profiling

- ERNIE-4.5-VL: no speed measurement. Each decode step now skips one `isin` and a few small allocations; image and video prefill are unchanged.
- dLLM: the per-token fallback applies only when the page size is outside 1/64/128. `inclusionAI/LLaDA2.1-mini` (page 32) ran about 20% slower in the 10-question check.

## Checklist

- [x] Format your code according to the [Format code with pre-commit](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#format-code-with-pre-commit).
- [x] Add unit tests according to the [Run and add unit tests](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#run-and-add-unit-tests). `test/manual/models/test_ernie45_vl_visual_mask.py` (manual, kept out of CI and nightly) covers the ERNIE-4.5-VL routing gate: a video-only prefill must mask its video tokens, and decode and text-only batches must not build the mask. The ERNIE-4.5-VL crash and the dLLM fixes need full models on XPU, which the runs above cover.
- [ ] Update documentation according to [Write documentations](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#write-documentations). Not needed.
- [x] Provide accuracy and speed benchmark results according to [Test the accuracy](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#test-the-accuracy) and [Benchmark the speed](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#benchmark-the-speed).
- [x] Follow the SGLang code style [guidance](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#code-style-guidance).

+"""Ernie4.5-VL forward must route every image and video token to the vision experts.
+
+The visual-token mask is built for any prefill batch that carries image or video
+inputs, and skipped for decode and text-only batches.
+"""
+
+import unittest
+from unittest.mock import MagicMock, patch
+
+import torch
+
+from sglang.test.test_utils import CustomTestCase
+
+IM_PATCH_ID, VIDEO_START_ID, VIDEO_END_ID = 100, 101, 102
+VIDEO_PAD = 5000
+
+
+def _make_model():
+    from sglang.srt.models.ernie45_vl import Ernie4_5_VLMoeForConditionalGeneration
+
+    model = Ernie4_5_VLMoeForConditionalGeneration.__new__(
+        Ernie4_5_VLMoeForConditionalGeneration
+    )
+    torch.nn.Module.__init__(model)
+    model.is_mrope_enabled = False
+    model._visual_token_ids_tensor_cache = torch.tensor(
+        [IM_PATCH_ID, VIDEO_START_ID, VIDEO_END_ID]
+    )
+    model.visual_token_mask = None
+    model.model = MagicMock()
+    model.lm_head = MagicMock()
+    model.logits_processor = MagicMock()
+    return model
+
+
+def _make_forward_batch(*, decode: bool, image: bool, video: bool):
+    from sglang.srt.managers.schedule_batch import Modality, MultimodalDataItem
+
+    item = MultimodalDataItem(modality=Modality.VIDEO, pad_value=VIDEO_PAD)
+    fb = MagicMock()
+    fb.forward_mode.is_decode.return_value = decode
+    fb.contains_image_inputs.return_value = image
+    fb.contains_video_inputs.return_value = video
+    fb.mm_inputs = [MagicMock(mm_items=[item])]
+    return fb
+
+
+def _mask_passed_to_language_model(input_ids, forward_batch):
+    with patch(
+        "sglang.srt.models.ernie45_vl.general_mm_embed_routine"
+    ) as embed_routine:
+        _make_model().forward(input_ids, torch.zeros_like(input_ids), forward_batch)
+    return embed_routine.call_args.kwargs["visual_token_mask"]
+
+
+class TestErnie45VLVisualTokenMask(CustomTestCase):
+    def test_video_only_prefill_masks_video_tokens(self):
+        input_ids = torch.tensor(
+            [1, VIDEO_START_ID, VIDEO_PAD, VIDEO_PAD, VIDEO_END_ID, 2]
+        )
+        mask = _mask_passed_to_language_model(
+            input_ids, _make_forward_batch(decode=False, image=False, video=True)
+        )
+        self.assertIsNotNone(mask)
+        self.assertEqual(
+            mask.flatten().tolist(), [False, True, True, True, True, False]
+        )
+
+    def test_decode_and_text_only_batches_skip_the_mask(self):
+        for decode, image, video in ((True, True, True), (False, False, False)):
+            with self.subTest(decode=decode, image=image, video=video):
+                mask = _mask_passed_to_language_model(
+                    torch.tensor([1, 2, 3]),
+                    _make_forward_batch(decode=decode, image=image, video=video),
+                )
+                self.assertIsNone(mask)
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    unittest.main()

CUDA check on 1x NVIDIA H200 NVL (tp 1). Both runs use the same image (`lmsysorg/sglang:nightly-dev-20261015-a6a8c560`) with the sglang Python source taken from each commit:
- before: merge-base `6daae9c98e`
- after: this PR `69662a3a88`

| Task | Before | After |
| --- | --- | --- |
| docvqa_val, 1000 docs, anls | 0.9269 | 0.9270 |
| docvqa_val, all 5349 docs, anls | 0.9221 | 0.9224 |
| gsm8k, 1319 questions, strict / flexible | 0.7005 / 0.8514 | 0.7036 / 0.8560 |

No regression on CUDA. docvqa covers image prefill, which still builds the mask. gsm8k covers text-only batches, which now skip it.

```bash
sglang serve --model-path baidu/ERNIE-4.5-VL-28B-A3B-PT --tp-size 1 --mem-fraction-static 0.85 \
  --trust-remote-code --context-length 8192 --enable-multimodal   # gsm8k: same, without --enable-multimodal

python3 -m lmms_eval --model openai --model_args model_version=baidu/ERNIE-4.5-VL-28B-A3B-PT,num_concurrent=8 \
  --tasks docvqa_val --batch_size 8 --limit 1000 --seed 42 --gen_kwargs enable_thinking=false,max_new_tokens=64

lm_eval --model local-completions \
  --model_args pretrained=baidu/ERNIE-4.5-VL-28B-A3B-PT,base_url=http://127.0.0.1:30000/v1/completions,num_concurrent=16 \
  --tasks gsm8k --num_fewshot 5 --batch_size 16 --seed 42 --gen_kwargs max_gen_toks=1024
```

https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/46623#discussion_r4397137380

Video-only prefill does not satisfy `contains_image_inputs()`, so this clears the visual mask and routes video tokens through text experts. **This also changes CUDA behavior**.

Keep the mask construction for both image and video input!
better to add a video-only routing regression test.

@mingfeima @airMeng Fixed in dfb591e335. The mask is now built whenever a prefill batch has image or video inputs, so video-only prefill routes its video tokens through the vision experts again, as on main. Decode and text-only batches still skip it, which is what the XPU fix needs.

Added `test/registered/unit/models/test_ernie45_vl_visual_mask.py` (CPU): a video-only prefill must mask its video tokens, and decode and text-only batches must not build the mask. The video case fails without the fix; both pass with it, on this branch and on current main.
This landed in main through #46623 (80afdc1280), which carries this PR's head 5328b9829f: the ERNIE-4.5-VL image-or-video mask gate and the dLLM fix from #41773. Closing.
